newsitem.title: TURKEY: Nine dead in Turkish minibus crash.
newsitem.headline: Nine dead in Turkish minibus crash.

text.p: Nine people died when a minibus carrying students crashed in the western Turkish province of Izmir, the state-run Anatolian news agency said on Tuesday.
The accident, in which 22 were injured, occurred on Monday evening after the minibus failed to round a corner and overturned in a ditch, Anatolian said.
The minibus was carrying students and staff from a local college on an outing to a factory. The injured were being treated at nearby hospitals.
